regions.text:
℞. Sem. papav. alb. contuſ. ℥ ij.
Cum Aq. decoct. hord.  F. emulſio, cujus
℥ x adde
Syr. diacod. ℥ jß.
Tinct. opii cum S. V. rectif. gtt. xx.
Aq. ſtillat. cinnamom. ʒ ij.
Cortic. citrei ʒ x.
regions.translation:
Take: white poppy seed, bruised, 2 ounces.
With barley-decoction water make an emulsion; to 10 ounces of it add
Syrup of diacodion (poppy-head syrup), 1½ ounces.
Tincture of opium made with rectified spirit of wine, 20 drops.
Distilled water of cinnamon, 2 drachms.
[Distilled water] of citron peel, 10 drachms.

regions.text: S. Capiat ℥ jß. omni ½ hora, donec incipiat leniri dolor.
regions.translation: Label: let the patient take 1½ ounces every half hour, until the pain begins to be eased.

regions.text:
℞. Semin. cardui mariæ.
Bardanæ.
Fœniculi ana ʒ vj.
Papaver. alb. ℥ j.
Amigdal. dulc. n°· xx.
Infuſi rad. liquorit. q. ſ.
F. l. a. emulſio.   Colatur ℔ iij. admiſce
Sal. prunellæ ʒ ij.
Syr. papaver. alb. ℥ jß.
regions.translation:
Take: seed of Our Lady's thistle [Silybum marianum],
of burdock [Arctium lappa],
of fennel, of each 6 drachms.
White poppy [seed], 1 ounce.
Sweet almonds, twenty in number.
Infusion of liquorice root, a sufficient quantity.
Make an emulsion according to the art. To 3 pounds of the strained liquor admix
Sal prunella [fused nitre, potassium nitrate], 2 drachms.
Syrup of white poppy, 1½ ounces.
Let it be given for use.

regions.text:
S. Bibat omni ſemihora ℥ ij. ſervetur lagena ſub aquâ
frigida, aut in cella.
regions.translation: Label: let the patient drink 2 ounces every half hour; let the flagon be kept under cold water, or in a cellar.
See Boerhaave, the same work [Materia Medica], p. 229.

regions.text:
℞. Gumm. opoponac. ʒ j.
Vitell. ovor. ʒ ij.
regions.translation:
Take: gum opopanax [Opopanax chironium], 1 drachm.
Yolks of eggs, 2 drachms.

regions.text:
M. ſ. a. dein adde
Sapon. venet. ʒ j.
Syrup. artemiſ. ℥ jß.
Aq. ſtillat. fœniculi ℥ iij.
regions.translation:
Mix according to the art; then add
Venice soap, 1 drachm.
Syrup of mugwort [Artemisia vulgaris], 1½ ounces.
Distilled water of fennel, 3 ounces.

regions.text: S. Capiat ʒ j omni quadrihorio, cum regimine.
regions.translation: Label: let the patient take 1 drachm every four hours, together with the [prescribed] regimen.
